handoffs.message: Ready for review: added services/execution/lean_runtime/runtime_context.py and test_runtime_context.py. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/execution/lean_runtime -q (26 passed).

Review needs changes: raw secret detection is too permissive because _keys/_path suffixes are globally whitelisted; api_keys/PANTHEON_API_KEYS-style raw secret inputs can pass. Narrow the secret-reference allowlist and add regression tests before approval.

Narrowed runtime-context secret reference allowlist by removing global _keys/_path suffix exemptions; added regression tests proving api_keys/PANTHEON_API_KEYS and private_key_path/PANTHEON_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH are rejected while explicit secret reference fields remain allowed. Verified with pytest -q services/execution/lean_runtime/test_runtime_context.py.

Review blocked: from_mapping/from_manifest normalizes runtime_context before secret validation, so a launch manifest with {'runtime_context': <valid context>, 'broker_secret': 'plain-secret'} is accepted. This violates SD-P0-03 raw broker secret failure behavior and README_P0_SD_INDEX hard invariant that no broker secret may appear in launch manifest. Focused pytest passes (pytest -q services/execution/lean_runtime/test_runtime_context.py: 9 passed), but add a regression test for wrapper-level raw secret rejection and validate the original manifest payload before dropping wrapper fields.

Review-ready after blocking fix: from_mapping now scans the original manifest payload before runtime_context normalization, so wrapper-level raw broker secrets are rejected. Added regression test_runtime_context_rejects_wrapper_manifest_raw_secrets. Verification: pytest -q services/execution/lean_runtime/test_runtime_context.py (10 passed).

Review blocker: PantheonRuntimeContext.from_mapping rejects the actual RuntimeBootstrapRequest.to_dict() launch manifest from P0-BOOT-001 because bridge.path is /workspace/lean and is chosen before bridge.source_path=pantheon/lean, then validation compares bridge.path to PANTHEON_LEAN_SOURCE_PATH. Add bootstrap-manifest interop coverage and normalize bridge.source_path for the context bridge path while preserving secret rejection. Verification: pytest -q services/execution/lean_runtime/test_runtime_context.py passed; ad hoc RuntimeBootstrapRequest.to_dict() repro fails with RuntimeContextError bridge.path must be 'pantheon/lean', got '/workspace/lean'.

Review-ready after bootstrap manifest interop fix: RuntimeContext now prefers bridge.source_path over runtime bridge.path, preserves bridge.path fallback and raw-secret rejection. Verification: pytest -q services/execution/lean_runtime/test_bootstrap_contract.py services/execution/lean_runtime/test_runtime_context.py passed; ad hoc RuntimeBootstrapRequest.to_dict() repro maps /workspace/lean to pantheon/lean.
Review approved: runtime context model and validation satisfy P0-CTX-001 acceptance; tests pass and bridge.source_path interop is verified. Returned to Codex2 for closeout/finalization.
